'''Ty'oper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was present on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ty'oper first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He was at some point removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
